title: Catalog template preset lost on create
current_behavior: defaultConfig carries art, the strict schema rejects it, create.ts falls back to {} so every catalog invitation starts empty (ADR-O01, runtime-verified at 2c94140)
competitor_evidence: defect (no competitor reference)
proposed_improvement: Validate the preset without art; art stays template-owned and is resolved by template_id; regression test catalog template -> created invitation keeps preset keys
quick_win: yes: one function plus a test

title: Event times in server time zone with a hard-coded WIB label

competitor_evidence: IVT and INV show WIB labels on every opened demo (C-IVT-101; C-INV-111)
proposed_improvement: Format each event in its own IANA zone (Asia/Jakarta / Makassar / Jayapura) with the matching label; test under TZ=UTC

title: Marketing price copy contradicts lib/pricing.ts

title: Unverified Qur'an translations in template presets

competitor_evidence: SMO / ENV / IVT / INV / KAT all show verse blocks (S-SMO-004; C-ENV-111) - provenance unknown everywhere

title: Guessable guest links act as the only credential

title: RSVP answer overwrites the host's pax allowance

title: No rate limiting or spam control on guest writes

title: Guest page uncacheable and loader runs twice
